entities.summary: Hichem Driss is a Tunisian photographer, educated at the École de communication visuelle in Paris. A freelance photographer since 2002, he has often cooperated with other photographers within fashion, design, architecture and art photography. In his series #404, Driss deals with the sudden freedom from censorship in the wake of the Jasmine Revolution in 2011.
